Source.// Kind: Oracle - the plant feed, read from what Crm04.Feeder writes. REQUIRED: there is no default, and an unset or unrecognised value refuses to start. 'Replay' (simulator output) is refused outside Development; see appsettings.Development.json.

Oracle.// StartAtLatest: Begin at the newest frame rather than replaying history a 10 Hz UI could never catch up from.
Oracle.// CatchUpThreshold: If more frames than this are pending, publish only the newest. The API holds one MachineState, not a queue.
